reviews.text:
Almost perfect minimalist keto. I love the simplicity of this app. I’m glad it doesn’t have any extra, unnecessary weight that the other apps have. However, it desperately needs one fix...

The majority of keto dieters use net carbs. This app cannot do net carbs. There is really only one way to do this while maintaining the simplicity of the app...
 
Allow the user to manually adjust calories instead of auto-calculating so that the user can enter NET carbs in the carbs slider and then compensate (fix) the calories that come up short as a result. 

It may seem like the better option would be to allow the user to choose if they want to count net carbs in the settings, and then give them a fiber slider if the feature is turned on. But that wouldn’t work because you would also have to account for sugar alcohols, and then different sugar alcohols behave differently when calculating net carbs. It would be a mess. So in my mind, this is not an option. 

So really, the best, cleanest solution would be to allow manual adjustments of calories. Give us a toggle switch to turn on or off manual calorie adjustments. Simple and just as clean as it is currently. 

This one little feature is making me question using the app as I currently have to ignore the calories completely and only enter net carbs in the carb slider. I have to use the macro goals ONLY, to know if I’m on track. Calories will always be lower than actual.

Please fix this one little thing and your app will be perfect!

reviews.text: Finally something usable. Forget all the other Marco trackers on here. It could probably be polished up a little on the appearance side of things, but again, for real world use you aren’t spending loads of time in this app anyway. You have to do all of that work yourself, but honestly after a week of use you’ll probably have everything you need for the most part.
